shortDescription: Merges the contents of a registry file into the Windows registry

options.name: compare_to
options.description: The parent key to use when comparing the contents of the registry to the contents of the file.  Needs to be in HKLM or HKCU part of registry. Use a PS-Drive style path for example HKLM:\SOFTWARE not HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE If not supplied, or the registry key is not found, no comparison will be made, and the module will report changed.

options.name: content
options.description: When used instead of O(path), merges the value specified into the Windows registry. It must not include the Byte Order Mark.

options.name: path
options.description: The full path including file name to the registry file on the remote machine to be merged
